Command: Do not hate your brother in your heart
Summary: One of the neighbour-laws of Leviticus 19:17-18: do not hate your brother in your heart, part of the passage that ends in 'thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.'
Commandment: Do not hate your brother in your heart
Application: Jesus joins this neighbour rule to love of God as the hinge of the Law (Matthew 22:39-40); love of neighbour is the measure of love of God in practice.
Purpose: Leviticus 19:18 states the neighbor rule; Jesus joins it to love of God as the hinge of the Law (Matthew 22:39-40).
